Name: Extreme Fishing Overhaul
Author: unidarkshin
Description:
[color=#00ffff][size=6][center][b]Extreme Fishing Overhaul[/b][/center][/size][/color]
Extreme Fishing Overhaul allows you to randomly generate up to 3000+ extra fish in a random location and a random season. This mod works with Level Extender to allow fishing level requirements up to and including level 100.

These fish are all randomly generated (Including their names and rarity!!) 

The fish have a higher difficulty based on their level requirements, this means if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1471]Level Extender[/url] you can catch even more fish!

Download now and get fishing!

[left][color=#e06666][size=3][u][b]Not Compatible:

[b][color=#ea9999][size=2][u] - DOES NOT WORK WITH SVE [/u]or any mods that change/replace locations on the map (currently looking for a solution).[/size][/color][/b][/b][/u][/size][/color][/left]

[b][u][color=#8e7cc3][size=4]Configuration: [/size][/color][/u][/b]

Configurable settings are generated after the first game run. Please load a save to generate the config file. It is located at [color=#ffe599]Stardew Valley/Mods/ExtremeFishingOverhaul/config.json

{
  "seed": XXXX, [b]## (Randomly generated on first load. **If using in multiplayer use the same seed!**)[/b]
  "maxFishingLevel": 100, [b]## Do not change unless you know what you are doing. (Default 10, if level extender is installed it defaults to 100)[/b]
  "minFishingLevel": 1, [b]## Do not change unless you know what you are doing.[/b]
  "maxLevOverride": false,[b] ## Do not change unless you know what you are doing.[/b]
  "maxFish": 1000 [b]## Changes the amount of extra fish generated (Don't go over 3200 if you like stability.) [/b]
}[/color]


[color=#00ff00][size=4][u][b]Recommended mods:[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1471]Level Extender[/url] (Allows fish to be generated up to and including fishing level 100)
[/list]

[color=#1e84cc][size=4][u][b]Compatibility:[/b]
[/u][/size][/color]
- Should be compatible with most mods that don't edit locations. Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]JSON Assets[/url] by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/34250790] spacechase0[/url]﻿ to inject fish data.





[center]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url] for helping with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]JSON Assets[/url] compatibility and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/30800940]Deathest1[/url]﻿ for the cute little fish sprites.[/center]
